hints: How can the robot have arrived at a given cell? There are only two possibilities.
From the cell above or the cell to its left - so the routes to a cell are the routes to those two, added together.
Fill the grid top to bottom and left to right, so both of those are known before the cell is reached. A blocked cell has zero routes.
The first row and the first column need care: they have only one neighbour to come from, and a block anywhere in them cuts off everything after it.
